entity_raw.definition_raw:
You might be a different subspecies or simply a well-fed and well-grown beast, but either way you’re built on a more massive scale than the rest of your kind.

Prerequisite(s): Animal companion or familiar.

Benefit(s): You treat your size as one category larger for the purposes of calculating CMB, CMD, carrying capacity, and any size-based special attacks you use or that are used against you (such as grab, swallow whole, and trample).
